messages.content: Find a yoga retreat in New York that includes vegetarian meals and spa services.

function.name: hotel_search_find_hotels
function.description: Search for hotels based on location and amenities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. New York, NY.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but the hotel‑search tool I have access to only supports a limited set of amenities (Breakfast, Fitness Centre, Free Wi‑Fi, Parking). It can’t filter for “vegetarian meals” or “spa services,” which are the key features you’re looking for in a yoga retreat.

However, I can still help you find a suitable yoga retreat in New York! Here are a few well‑known options that typically offer vegetarian meals and spa services:

| Retreat | Location | Typical Amenities |
|---------|----------|-------------------|
| **Shambhala Mountain Center** | Woodstock, NY (about 2 hrs from NYC) | Yoga & meditation classes, vegetarian/vegan meals, on‑site spa & massage |
| **The Farmhouse Retreat** | Hudson Valley, NY | Yoga workshops, plant‑based meals, spa & wellness treatments |
| **Yoga Retreat at The Lodge at Woodloch** | Hawley, PA (near NY border) | Yoga & fitness, vegetarian cuisine, spa & massage |
| **The Yoga Barn (NYC)** | Manhattan, NY | Daily yoga, vegetarian food options, partner spa services |
| **Sivananda Ashram** | Westchester County, NY | Yoga & Ayurveda, vegetarian meals, spa & massage |

If you’d like more detailed information—such as pricing, schedules, or how to book—I can look up the websites or contact details for each place. Just let me know which one interests you most, or if you’d like me to search for additional options!
